title: Core Operator Inventory Census — Consolidation Pressure and Next Work
purpose: Summarize high-frequency operator families and route future consolidation through canonical owners instead of creating additional generic masters.
method: Filename/path inventory plus canonical-owner review. Counts below are filename/path hits from the current repository tree and therefore measure visible fragmentation pressure, not semantic frequency inside file contents.

families.next_action: Audit generic Axis definitions across axis-model/topology/operators/world-model and convert repeated prose to owner pointers + subtype-specific semantics.
Separate generic Door law from religious, legal, UI, physical and science-specific Door embodiments.
Migrate old generic 'cross' wording into cross-point, cross-sign, crossing-event or Christian-Cross context.
Classify each spiral file as recurrence law, geometry, dynamics, archaeology, science benchmark or reader view.
Keep literal biology, Tree of Life, Knowledge, Strife, world-tree, archive-tree and organizational tree explicitly typed.
Separate Swamp regime/terrain from datasets, cases, research seeds and lower-field semantics.
Plane semantics are now consolidated; update older specialists opportunistically as touched.
Protect exact geometry from art-historical, theological and esoteric interpretations.
Separate botanical root, provenance root, source-origin, causal root and project Father/Root relation.
Separate biological seed/grain/tuber-eye from transferable-future-capacity operator and human-record seed datasets.

consolidation_layers.question: What invariant rules must implementations obey?
What subtype/domain-specific mechanism is being studied?
How is the same operator shown to a reader?
Where is duplication or orphan pressure?

immediate_merge_queue: Axis family: reconcile data/axis-model.json, data/axis-topology.json, data/axis-operators.json, knowledge/core/axis-world-model.json under data/axis-flow-contract.json.
Door family: classify the 33 visible Door-named files as contract, embodiment, archaeology, science model, comparative religion or reader view.
Cross family: audit pre-2026-09-20 files for ambiguous 'Cross' and migrate to cross-point/cross-sign/crossing-event/Christian-cross labels.
Spiral family: mark which files own recurrence law vs geometry/dynamics/archaeology and add the Plane-return-map relation where appropriate.
Tree family: create a family registry if current tree-plane-routing does not yet enumerate all literal/comparative/project subtypes.
Swamp family: keep Below/Manifestation distinction visible in every public/data route.
success_metrics: One obvious definition/contract owner for every high-frequency operator.
Every specialist names the owner it specializes instead of repeating a generic definition.
Every research synthesis preserves provenance links to source/specialist owners.
Every public projection can be replaced without changing canonical ownership.
New files are created only when they add a distinct schema, mechanism, evidence layer, timeline or reader function.
